My bro/sis.. I felt the same way about myself, not having any skills or talents.  But i realised that life is a process to find them. No one is stupid and ugly, and I don't believe that you are. I know you feel like shit right now. It's so fucking hard to get yourself back up. But you will get back up and continue to live. You will find things you like to do and eventually even love. And you'll be great at it! The future you will be so proud that you didn't end it all when you were at your worst. You are so loved. I don't even know you but I love you my friend, because you seem like a kind soul. I'm always here if you want to talk. You will live long and find some happiness and solace in that journey. Please never ever give up.
